title: Update the delivery contract to the flat layout
outcome: WORKFLOW.md describes the layout that exists, so the next Change is not created against a directory structure the repository no longer has.
acceptanceCriteria: The Implementation-slice contract's directory tree shows content/changes/<change-slug>/ with no lifecycle segment, and change.json is documented as carrying lifecycle without status.
The sentence listing what a lifecycle move touches is replaced: advancing a Change edits change.json and nothing else.
Archive step 6 no longer moves or renames a directory; it sets lifecycle to archived and adds archivedAt.
docs/agents/artifact-lifecycle.md agrees with WORKFLOW.md on the layout.
New prose is hard-wrapped to the width the surrounding file already uses.
